file_reasoning: Employee roster editor for identity, compensation, lifecycle and delivery eligibility.

resource_binding_reasoning.reasoning: Root explicit nested selection command,330px roster plus remaining editor; rows have name/number/job. No search filter in this view; large roster navigation requires manual scrolling.
Form or empty instruction exclusive. Middle editor ScrollViewer and pinned save/footer support many fields; header/footer reduce available middle area with long errors.
All wage types remain visible, optional salary/overtime distinct from required daily/shift values. Numeric InputScope alone does not validate; all server fields disabled CanEdit.
Work arrangement, lifecycle, active and can-deliver independent two-way controls. Potential contradictory combinations must be validated by VM/domain, not hidden in UI.
National ID and biometric ID treated ordinary editable text; no real records inspected. UI authorization inherited CanEdit only, permission enforcement independently backend-reviewed.
Retry-aware caption and CanEdit gating; errors/success wrap. No loading/error empty state over roster in this markup, so initial read failure presentation depends ActionError/VM; native not observed.

tests_and_limits: NOT_EXECUTED. Test retained create/update restart, all compensation values roundtrip, long field headers/narrow widths, roster read failure and native focus trap. No callable declarations.
recommendations: Keep compensation fields independent and validate lifecycle coherence server-side; expose roster load state and accessible action feedback.
observation: SOURCE_ONLY; no native screenshot/runtime evidence; no source or application state changed
